project_meta.name: Katey Elinam - Premium Portfolio
project_meta.theme: Dark Mode (Light toggle supported but secondary)
project_meta.archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) infused with Archetype 7 (Futuristic/Neon) for AI & Tech elements
project_meta.vibe: Cinematic, mysterious, elite, deeply personal, 8K-quality visual standard

headings.usage_rules: No Inter/Roboto/Open Sans. Maximum size text-6xl for Hero. Use fluid scaling (clamp). Never center by default.

accent_mono.usage_rules: Uppercase. Used for overlines, AI chat assistant text, code blocks, loading screen data.

rules.contrast: APCA standard compliant. Minimum 4.5:1 for body text against backgrounds.
rules.gradients: No generic linear gradients. Use radial glows for neon accents behind focal points.
rules.textures: Must use subtle CSS/SVG noise grain overlay (pointer-events-none, fixed, opacity-20) across the entire site.

layout_spacing.container: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24.
layout_spacing.grid_system: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid for projects and about bento. Asymmetric, gaps of gap-8 to gap-12. No standard Bootstrap columns.
layout_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Asymmetry preferred for visual tension.

sections.hero: 100vh, full screen, centralized but dynamic composition
sections.projects: Bento or Masonry with wide gaps
sections.footer: py-32, massive typography for contact CTA (text-[10vw])

cards.style: The 'Tracing Beam' + Grid Borders. Expose the skeleton.
cards.hover: GSAP 3D tilt (transform-style: preserve-3d) + subtle neon radial glow.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant). backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60. 1px inner border-white/10.

ai_elements.style: Retro-Futurism. Terminal look with JetBrains Mono, neon cyan borders (border-cyan-500/50), and soft drop-shadow glows.

interactions.cursor: Magnetic custom cursor with trailing particle field (Canvas or GSAP).
interactions.hero_intro: Letter-by-letter scramble animation on name (GSAP TextPlugin or custom logic), typewriter effect on role.
interactions.scroll: Parallax scrolling sections. Lenis smooth scroll. Scroll-triggered reveal animations (fade up + scale).
interactions.3d_cards: Awwwards-style 3D tilt on project cards (rotateX/Y mapped to mouse movement).
interactions.timeline: Vertical SVG line that draws itself via ScrollTrigger as user scrolls down the Experience section.
interactions.skills: Interactive bubble/tag clusters by category. Framer motion physics or D3 force graph.

3d_creative_strategy.hero_mesh: React Three Fiber particle mesh representing 'AI & Code'. Interactive to mouse movement.
3d_creative_strategy.orbiting_skills: Use Framer Motion to create circular orbiting paths for skill badges around the profile photo in the About section.

profile_photo.description: Katey Elinam professional portrait. Apply cinematic masking, perhaps a monochrome filter via CSS to blend with the dark tech theme.

hero_background.description: 8K ultra-premium cinematic abstract background with glowing cyan particles.

project_stockhub.description: AI-powered inventory system thumbnail. Dark mode 3D render.

project_greendev.description: GreenDev Associates thumbnail. Moody eco-tech aesthetic.

project_flowitec.description: Flowitec LMS thumbnail. Futuristic abstract visualization.

cv.name: Katey Elinam
cv.education: BSc Earth Science, University of Ghana

component_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='contact-submit-button'.
component_rules.shadcn_ui: Use sparingly. For forms (Input, Textarea), strip 'Vercel-look'. Overwrite rounded corners to sharp (rounded-none).
component_rules.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for high-end duotone or bold tech icons.
component_rules.ai_chat: Implement as a floating terminal-style widget, fixed to bottom right. Use Framer Motion for entrance/exit.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize the project with React, Tailwind CSS. Avoid Shadcn for main layouts to ensure custom bento grid asymmetry.
3. Apply a global fixed CSS noise texture overlay to achieve the cinematic grain.
4. Cursor: Build custom magnetic cursor + trailing particle effect.
5. Hero Section: Implement R3F particle mesh bg. Name gets GSAP scramble animation; role gets typewriter. Include animated 'Available for work' floating status.
6. AI Features: 1) Floating Claude Sonnet 4.5 chat assistant (mock/API). 2) AI project summarizer on project hover/click. 3) AI Message Polish button on contact form.
7. Personalization: Read document.referrer to display personalized greeting in Hero or Chat.
8. Projects: Implement 3D tilt hover cards using 'preserve-3d'. Map mouse to rotation.
9. Experience: Build vertical animated timeline with drawing connector lines (GSAP DrawSVG or ScrollTrigger on SVG stroke-dashoffset).
10. Skills: Create interactive bubble/tag clusters. About section needs orbiting badges around the profile photo.
11. Contact Form: Integrate Resend email (or mock endpoint).
12. Footer: Implement webgl/css ripple wave effect.
13. Ensure dark/light toggle is present, but heavily optimize for the ultra-premium Dark Mode.
14. Use the EXACT image URLs provided in media_assets. No placeholders.
15. Add branded loading screen (Retro-Futurism terminal style or minimalist logo reveal) that waits for 3D/fonts to load.
